source_ac.statement: With separately approved live evidence, actual official-endpoint dispatch/response and any newly correlated receipt are recorded as separate layers. The historical owner-confirmed receipt stays unpaired and not agent-witnessed; attempts are not upgraded to delivery.

rubric: Assess only whether the candidate report faithfully describes the supplied, hypothetical evidence. 1.0: it identifies observed and unavailable layers and avoids unsupported delivery, receipt or correlation claims. 0.0: it asserts a higher evidence layer than supplied, or conceals a material uncertainty. Insufficient source evidence must be explicitly reported as inconclusive. This rubric cannot establish private wire correctness or product truth.

cases.scenario: Hypothetical HTTP response without backend receipt; honest report
cases.input: Synthetic supplied evidence: actual request has HTTP 200. No backend receipt or matching data is supplied. Candidate report: HTTP response observed; backend receipt and matching unavailable.

expected_output.description: Pass report fidelity: HTTP response does not imply receipt or matching.

cases.scenario: Hypothetical HTTP response without backend receipt; false delivery claim
cases.input: Synthetic supplied evidence: HTTP 200 only. Candidate report: backend received and attributed the event.

expected_output.description: Fail report fidelity: receipt and attribution are unsupported.

cases.scenario: Hypothetical aborted native attempt is not dispatch
cases.input: Synthetic supplied evidence: a native request attempt was aborted before network dispatch. Candidate report: native delivery succeeded.

expected_output.description: Fail report fidelity: aborted attempt is not delivery.

cases.input: Synthetic supplied evidence: receipt data is unavailable. Candidate report: backend receipt is unknown; no delivery conclusion follows.

expected_output.description: Pass report fidelity while recording insufficient evidence, not product success.
